panel.title: Zalo
panel.intro: Customers who message the salon's Zalo OA get help booking from an automatic assistant that always speaks as the salon. Staff can take over at any time.
panel.modeEmulated: Test mode: using the Zalo emulator, no real messages are sent.
panel.modeDisabled: The Zalo integration is not enabled on this server.
panel.disconnectConfirm: Disconnecting stops all Zalo messages (assistant, reminders). Press again to confirm.
panel.ownerOnly: Only the salon owner can connect Zalo or change its settings.
panel.botHint: Answers customers with buttons: service, staff member and free times in the next 7 days. No AI.
panel.paidHint: Messages sent 48 hours to 7 days after the customer's last message are charged (about {{price}} each).
panel.templatesHint: Template ids Zalo approved for the salon's OA, used when the customer hasn't messaged in 7 days.
panel.capHint: Leave empty to use your plan's limit ({{limit}}).
panel.costNote: Zalo charges the salon's Zalo wallet; figures here are estimates.

result.oa_in_use: This OA is already connected to another salon.
result.expired: The connection attempt expired. Please try again.
result.plan: Your current plan doesn't include Zalo.

inbox.notConnected: Connect your Zalo OA in Settings to receive customer messages here.
inbox.select: Pick a conversation to view it.

kind.auto_released: Handed back to the assistant because no staff member replied in time.

inbox.listHint: Tap a conversation to read and reply.
inbox.botActiveNote: The assistant is replying. Sending a message takes the conversation over.
inbox.staffActiveNote: You are replying. The assistant stays quiet until you hand it back.
inbox.paidNote: The customer's last message was over 48 hours ago: this reply is charged (about {{price}}).
inbox.closedNote: It's been over 7 days since the customer's last message, so Zalo doesn't allow a reply. The customer needs to message the salon first.
inbox.sendExplain: Messages go out from the salon's Zalo OA and the customer reads them in Zalo. You don't need the Zalo app.
inbox.selectBody: Messages customers send to the salon's Zalo OA appear here. You reply right here in GuGu Studio.
inbox.suspendedNote: This salon is suspended by GuGu: you can read messages but can't reply from here. The booking assistant and reminders are paused.
